episode_summary: In this episode, Chris Linsell discusses the potential future of Zillow as a major brokerage, the impact of AI on real estate agents, and the stalled 21st Century Road to Housing Act. He emphasizes the importance of agents focusing on providing unique, localized insights and lifestyle consulting to remain valuable in the evolving industry landscape.
